title: Next attempt configuration
statement: Let $a$ be a configuration of $A$ on input $x$, and let $m$ be a natural number. The next-attempt configuration has the initial state of $A$, an input-head position obtained by moving left $m+1$ steps from $a$'s input-head position and then right one step, the same work-tape contents as $a$, and an empty output. Each work-tape head is shifted right by $3(m+1)$ cells.
